# Synthetic scanned OCR fixtures

These four image-only PDFs contain fictional Jordan Test and Taylor Example records. They came from the Medchron OCR Batch Update kit and are used by `tools/capture-release.cjs` to check real OCR, reviewed batch intake, and screenshots against the packaged Windows app.

They are not patient records. They are separate from the 30 approved demonstration PDFs in the Windows sample manifest and are not added to the installed sample set.
